nodes.name: application-local.yml
nodes.summary: Local-profile datasource override for customize-service: HikariCP pool pointing at the local MySQL damai_customize schema.

nodes.name: application-pro.yml
nodes.summary: Production-profile datasource override for customize-service: HikariCP pool pointing at the remote MySQL damai_customize schema.

nodes.name: application.yml
nodes.summary: Main Spring Boot configuration for customize-service (port 6084): Nacos discovery, Redis, Kafka consumer (api_data group, save_api_data topic), MyBatis-Plus with logic-delete, Feign/OkHttp, Actuator/Prometheus metrics, jasypt, and springdoc/knife4j API docs.

nodes.name: log4j2.xml
nodes.summary: Log4j2 logging configuration for customize-service with console and rolling-file appenders (100MB size / daily rollover, 30-file retention), a separate error log, traceId MDC pattern, and a commented-out Logstash socket appender.
